avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 and CYP2C9 inducer; may further increase phenobarbital metabolism and reduce efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; counsel on alternative mood support if needed

avoid_supplements.name: Valerian Root
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression with phenobarbital; increased risk of excessive sedation and respiratory depression
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid combination; educate on cumulative CNS depressant effects

avoid_supplements.name: Kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression and potential hepatotoxicity; phenobarbital also induces kava metabolism

caution_supplements.name: Calcium
caution_supplements.mechanism: Phenobarbital impairs vitamin D metabolism; chronic use increases osteoporosis risk
caution_supplements.action: Monitor bone health; may require supplementation with concurrent vitamin D

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin D
caution_supplements.mechanism: Phenobarbital induces CYP24A1, increasing vitamin D catabolism
caution_supplements.action: Assess serum vitamin D; supplement if deficient (common in chronic phenobarbital users)

caution_supplements.name: Folic Acid
caution_supplements.mechanism: Phenobarbital impairs folate absorption and metabolism; deficiency risk increases with long-term use
caution_supplements.action: Consider baseline and periodic folate monitoring; supplement if indicated

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin K
caution_supplements.mechanism: Phenobarbital induces hepatic metabolism affecting vitamin K-dependent clotting factors
caution_supplements.action: Monitor coagulation parameters; ensure adequate vitamin K intake

avoid_foods.name: Alcohol
avoid_foods.mechanism: Additive CNS depression; increased risk of severe sedation, respiratory depression, and overdose
avoid_foods.action: Absolute contraindication; provide clear patient education on complete alcohol avoidance

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase phenobarbital absorption variability; inconsistent bioavailability
caution_foods.action: Counsel consistent food intake patterns; take with or without food consistently

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor; may increase phenobarbital levels; however, phenobarbital's strong induction may override this effect
caution_foods.action: Avoid or limit consumption; monitor for toxicity signs if consumed

monitoring_notes: Phenobarbital is a potent inducer of multiple CYP450 enzymes and UGT pathways, significantly reducing effectiveness of many medications and supplements. Long-term use carries high risk of nutritional deficiencies (vitamin D, folate, calcium, vitamin K) and secondary osteoporosis; proactive screening and supplementation recommended. CNS depressant effects mandate strict avoidance of alcohol and other depressants.
